# Console HTTP API

The console UI is a client of this API; scripts and CI can use it too. Live OpenAPI: `/api/openapi.json`, interactive explorer: `/api/swagger`.

**Auth.** When `REALY_CONSOLE_TOKEN` is set every `/api/*` route except `/api/health` and `/api/auth/*` needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or the session cookie set by `POST /api/auth/login`. See [security.md](../security.md).

**Live telemetry.** WebSocket `/api/live` (session cookie, Bearer header or `?token=`) pushes JSON messages: `status` (run queue + current run, on connect and on change), `metrics` (1 s `MetricsSnapshot` per source: emitter, collector, gateway, model, flink), `log` (driver log lines) and `decision` (a rate-limited sample of decisions, ~20/s, for the live feed). History for a late joiner: `GET /api/live/history`. Unauthorised connections are closed with code 4401.

| `GET` | `/api/auth/me` |  |  | Me |
